strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux to Linux or Windows using unordered FakeTCP/FEC carriers plus a native standards-compliant DTLS 1.3 WBD security/session layer. Xray/VLESS/Vision/REALITY, WireGuard and Android are not part of the V2.1 product stack.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2-M3 native WBD session/control inside the locally qualified one-lane DTLS/FEC/FakeTCP path; M3A framing and M3B token auth passed, M3C keepalive/stats active
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Keep all M3 semantics inside an already-finished DTLS 1.3 association. Do not invent another cryptographic layer, reliable public byte stream or custom FEC. Do not start two-lane, kernel-anchor, TUN/L3, Windows, Auto or detector-specific shaping work before the M3 session/control gate passes. M3C should add only liveness/session accounting after Established; reconnect policy remains separate.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed V2-M3B through substantive commit 7458a5489f91b232af1577d72a330ee8d8b5b6b1. The M3A control codec now adds bounded AUTH (opaque 1..256-byte bearer token) and empty AUTH_OK frames plus explicit ERROR codes for AUTH-required, auth-failed and unexpected-state. A ServerSession state machine enforces AwaitHello -> AwaitAuth -> Established when a token is configured and AwaitHello -> Established when auth is disabled. Unsupported protocol or a wrong token fails closed; AUTH before HELLO, repeated HELLO while awaiting AUTH, retries after failure and control after Established are rejected deterministically. Configured/presented tokens are SHA-256 hashed to fixed 32-byte values and compared using crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare; this is only local comparison and does not replace DTLS or add protocol crypto. Local direct-DTLS authority used the accepted quiet shim SHA-256 63329b8528196159f430bb89bf40b98e52ed74073f57ed81d068cddb55e50d7a and wbd.test certificate path. In all cases both DTLS peers reached READY before HELLO/AUTH: auth-disabled reached Established after ACCEPT; matching token reached AUTH_OK/Established; wrong token returned ERROR code 5 and server state Failed. Source SHA-256 identities for the accepted local M3B content are control.go 0148bcc94e745daf0b8fd471a6bb5bb39a245330d5d7fc7772c214b9f6770269, control_test.go 1c650e3b505a1d0a8897b0ee88a84aa1ff3c913d8265e0a78c5f54881426f491, probe 09c96b5f8967291817885285ce26ec489af20c42dc67064e502d82e81e0ddf57, qualification script eb9d5219b7ee95077ac394d4843ab0a473a03b2a0a61dc46639fac4591243658, receipt 9466d0ec24cd4b57d149315673e402a8e33bc1a8d4d9182e4a56e9736e7ce841 and M3B doc bb646ede7f622fca44a9771aaa873e1ad16b769f92a4d2feb1960eca717f8290. GitHub ci, handoff-verify and build-quic-oracle all completed successfully for 7458a5489f91b232af1577d72a330ee8d8b5b6b1.
continuation_cursor.current_task: V2-M3C: add minimal liveness and session accounting after Established. Introduce bounded PING/PONG control messages with an opaque nonce and explicit session counters/last-activity tracking; no timer should create a reliable stream or retransmit application data.
continuation_cursor.why_now: Version negotiation and authorization are now explicit and qualified. Before reconnect or TUN semantics are added, the session needs a small way to detect a live peer and expose observable state without conflating carrier packet loss with application reliability. PING/PONG plus counters can be tested entirely inside the existing DTLS control channel.
continuation_cursor.done_when: M3C defines strict PING/PONG frames with fixed-size nonce encoding; PING is accepted only in Established and returns the same nonce in PONG; pre-auth or failed-state liveness frames are rejected; session stats track control messages/bytes, successful auth mode, ping/pong counts and last-activity time without recording bearer-token contents; an idle-policy helper can report expiry from caller-provided monotonic timestamps without spawning timers or retransmitting data; unit tests cover nonce round trips, ordering/state errors and idle boundaries; and a direct-DTLS loopback demonstrates established session PING->PONG for both auth-disabled and token-authenticated modes. Reconnect/TUN remain out of scope.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: V2-M3C: extend internal/control with fixed 8-byte PING and PONG nonce bodies and add session stats/last-activity fields to the existing server state machine using caller-supplied time values rather than hidden timers. Write unit tests for Established-only handling, nonce echo, counters and exact idle-expiry boundaries first. Then extend the direct DTLS probe/qualification to perform one PING/PONG after auth-disabled establishment and after successful token AUTH. Do not implement reconnect, application/L3 data framing or TUN yet.
